From download to your session.

Tested on macOS with Ableton Live 12 and Max 9. Requires Live Suite, or Live Standard with Max for Live.

  1. Unzip the download. Keep the device and all companion files in the same folder.
  2. Drag doppelgänger.amxd onto an audio track in Live.
  3. Load your source and at least one reference. New instances start empty.

One ZIP for macOS and Windows. Windows path handling is tested; a full Windows/Ableton check is still pending. Live 11 compatibility is not verified.

FFmpeg is needed for library audio imports and LUFS / true-peak scans. It is not bundled.
